name: clickflow
description: A stateful browser agent: complete plans, verified actions.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @clickflow/shared && concurrently --kill-others -n backend,extension "npm run dev -w @clickflow/backend" "npm run dev -w @clickflow/extension"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @clickflow/shared && npm run build -w @clickflow/backend && npm run build -w @clickflow/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @clickflow/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test:restart: npm run build -w @clickflow/shared && npm run build -w @clickflow/backend && node --test tests/restart.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:restart && npm run test:extension
